meta.title: Streamnest Media Tools – Video and Image Utilities
meta.description: Convert and compress video locally, or remove image backgrounds with Streamnest media tools.

hero.heading: Work with media
hero.intro: Convert and compress video on your device, or create a clean transparent image with AI background removal.

tools.title: Video Converter
tools.description: Convert a local video to MP4, WebM, or MP3 with a browser-based media engine.

tools.title: Video Compressor
tools.description: Choose a practical 480p, 720p, or 1080p quality preset and reduce a local file.

tools.title: Background Remover
tools.description: Upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP image and create a transparent PNG with AI.

home.privacyBody: Video conversion and compression stay in your browser. Background removal securely uploads only the image you choose for temporary processing.

meta.title: Free Local Video Converter – Convert Video in Your Browser
meta.description: Convert a local video to MP4, WebM, or MP3 in your browser without uploading the file to a server.

hero.heading: Convert video formats
hero.intro: Choose a video from your computer and convert it in this browser. The file stays on your device throughout processing.

notes: Processing stops if this tab closes
Large, batch, or 4K workflows are better suited to the future desktop app

meta.title: Free Local Video Compressor – Compress Video in Your Browser
meta.description: Reduce a local video file in your browser with practical quality presets and no server upload.

hero.heading: Make video files
hero.intro: Choose a practical size and quality balance, then compress the video directly on this device without sending it to a server.

notes: Small: compact 480p output for quick sharing
Balanced: practical 720p output for everyday use
The result depends on the source codec, motion, duration, and original bitrate

meta.title: AI Background Remover – Create a Transparent PNG
meta.description: Remove a JPG, PNG, or WebP image background and download a transparent PNG with Streamnest.

hero.heading: Remove an image
hero.intro: Upload one image, create a transparent result, and choose a simple preview background before downloading.

notes: Google sign-in protects the processing endpoint
Processed files use temporary private storage and result links
